quote.text: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
quote.author: Proverbs 9:17, King James Version (1611)

stories.kicker: The World · Iran, Kuwait And Italy
stories.headline: Drone strike in Kuwait kills two Rheinmetall Italia technicians
stories.dek: Italy and Kuwait blamed Iran for the 26 November attack on an air-defence site; Tehran denied any role and offered Rome a joint inquiry.

stories.headline: Nvidia halts AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
stories.dek: Dell and Supermicro told buyers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia that Nvidia will not authorise delivery, the Financial Times reported on 26 November.

stories.kicker: The Undercurrent · India: The Dar-e-Nijaat Watch Parties
stories.headline: Delhi fans buy tickets to watch Pakistan’s Dar-e-Nijaat together
stories.dek: About 45 people paid Rs 899 each at Cafe Otenga in Delhi on 21 November to watch an ARY Digital serial that India has kept off its screens since May 2025.

stories.kicker: Singapore · The CPF On Trial In Washington
stories.headline: Washington proposes tariffs of up to 20% on Singapore
stories.dek: The US Trade Representative’s 25 November finding blames Singapore’s Central Provident Fund and industrial plans; a trade deal would cut the rate to 10 per cent.

stories.headline: Chess Empire of Amritsar claims Jaques of London’s reproduction work
stories.dek: Jaques sells its ebony-and-boxwood 1849 Edition at £4,439 and names no workshop; Chessbazaar ships a comparable Indian-carved set to Singapore for US$730.

stories.headline: Huawei holds its Mate X8 foldable at last year’s price
stories.dek: Launched in China on 24 November from CNY 12,999, about US$1,830, the book-style phone opens for sale on 4 December, with no date anywhere else.

stories.headline: Christie’s Iconic 40 watch sale makes HK$296 million
stories.dek: The Hong Kong evening sale on 25 November sold 38 of its 40 lots, and a Patek Philippe Sky Moon Tourbillon led at HK$37.5 million, a touch behind an F.P. Journe.

stories.headline: Hexed and Focker-In-Law open below their Thanksgiving tracking
stories.dek: Disney’s Hexed took US$7.6 million and Universal’s Focker-In-Law US$5.3 million on 25 November; Variety expects Focker-In-Law to overtake by Sunday, with both short of the US$40–45 million forecast.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · Brain Types Behind Anxiety
stories.headline: Stanford study finds three brain types behind ADHD, anxiety
stories.dek: Yu Zhang’s team read resting brain scans of 3,508 American children aged 9 to 11 for Nature Mental Health; the patterns also showed in 693 children not yet diagnosed, though the paper gives no figure for how well that predicts.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · Asia Raises The Price Of Money
stories.headline: Bank of Korea lifts rates to 3.25% on chip boom
stories.dek: The Bank of Korea’s five-to-two vote on 26 November, a day after Seoul’s shares fell 6.2 per cent, was its third rise since July.

stories.headline: Changi Sailing Club closes dinghy season with 54 racers
stories.dek: The club’s Monthly Dinghy Race finale on 14 November put children and adults on one start line, six weeks after Singapore’s sailors took two Asian Games silvers in Japan.

stories.headline: José Afonso’s review finds stretching fails to prevent injuries
stories.dek: José Afonso’s team pooled 15 studies of 9,002 people aged 14 to 59 in Sports Medicine on 21 November; stretchers’ odds of injury came out at 0.945 of the others’, a gap indistinguishable from none.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Pop After Pop, Bruno Mars And DIVA
stories.headline: National Gallery Singapore stages Pop Art with the Guggenheim
stories.dek: More than 200 works open on 11 December at S$15–25, 30 per cent off until Monday; in Roppongi, the V&A’s DIVA arrives on 24 March.
